name: Brainly
summary: Homework help platform with AI explanations, test prep and optional human tutoring.
description: Brainly helps students with homework and turns missed topics into test preparation, with a learning advisor included and a weekly human tutor available as an add-on, according to its site description. The service is aimed at parents of teenagers as well as students.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Brainly's help center says there is a lifetime free Basic plan and paid subscriptions, plus a 7-day trial of a paid plan for first-time users.

howToUse.title: Open Brainly
howToUse.description: Go to Brainly. The service is aimed at students and at parents of teenagers.

howToUse.title: Work from homework
howToUse.description: Bring homework in so missed topics become test preparation.

howToUse.title: Use the advisor or add a tutor
howToUse.description: Use the learning advisor included with the service, or add the weekly human tutor as an add-on.

features: Homework help platform with AI explanations, test prep and optional human tutoring.

Brainly helps students with homework and turns missed topics into test preparation, with a learning advisor included and a weekly human tutor available as an add-on, according to its site description.
The service is aimed at parents of teenagers as well as students.
features_fr: Plateforme d'aide aux devoirs avec explications sur l'IA, préparation aux tests et tutorat humain en option.

Brainly aide les étudiants à faire leurs devoirs et transforme les sujets manqués en préparation aux tests, avec un conseiller d'apprentissage inclus et un tuteur humain hebdomadaire disponible en complément, selon la description de son site.
Le service s'adresse aux parents d'adolescents ainsi qu'aux étudiants.
